meta.title: About Jaka Marinko
meta.description: Endurance athlete, Faculty of Sport student and personal trainer. Junior national champion, U20 national team, VO₂max 80.

title: About me
intro: Endurance athlete, Faculty of Sport student and personal trainer.

bio.p1: Sport has been part of my life since childhood. Years of racing at the top junior level gave me experience I now combine with sports science.
bio.p2: At the Faculty of Sport I study physiology, biomechanics, training methodology and sport psychology. Results come from planning, consistency and an individual approach.

achievements.title: Results
achievements.champion: Multiple junior national champion: ski mountaineering, cross-country skiing, roller skiing, mountain running
achievements.redBull: Red Bull 400 Planica: 5th place, fastest junior

smarnaGora.title: Šmarna gora: progress measured in seconds
smarnaGora.subtitle: A climb up Šmarna gora every year, as a personal measure of how my endurance develops.
